Method of Attack: Exploiting vulnerabilities in QNAP NAS devices to remotely encrypt files using the built-in 7-zip application
Encrypting files and replacing them with password-protected 7-zip archives
Demanding ransom payments via Tor site
Bait-and-switch tactic by increasing ransom demands after initial payment
Indicators of Compromise: Tor ransom note site with message 'This site will be closed soon'
Bitcoin addresses used for ransom payments (22 known addresses)
